name: Clicking a thumbnail switches the main image

steps.description: Click the second thumbnail in the gallery
steps.snapshotHint: Look for .gthumb elements in .gallery-thumbs — click the second one

steps.script: (() => { const main = document.querySelector('.gallery-main .main-img'); return { src: main?.src || '', visible: main ? main.offsetWidth > 0 : false }; })()
steps.description: Main image is still visible after thumbnail click

businessContext: Thumbnail navigation lets customers inspect product details — broken switching frustrates buyers
